title: An install that follows Mainworks waits for a quiet moment before it updates
description: A running deploy watch for an install whose repository is not the Mainworks source has a review session in flight. A newer verified Mainworks build is published: the watch records which build waits and why, and restarts nothing until the review ends; then it serves the newer build.

steps.name: Publish a newer verified build during a stub review and see no restart until the review ends
